event.initial_firm_notification: Two or more of the following: Email, Fax, Letter, Press Release, Telephone, Visit
event.distribution_pattern: Distributed in California, Oregon, and Washington.

products.product_description: Pilgrim's Roasted Nut'Z Chocolate Toffee Almonds are packaged by hand into either the 8 oz Plastic Cone Bags or 8 Oz Pouch Bags. Label declares Almonds, Sugar, Hershey's Cocoa Powder, Ghirardelli Sweet Chocolate Powder, English Toffee Syrup.
products.reason_for_recall: Chocolate Toffee Almonds product is recalled due to undeclared milk and soy lecithin.

products.product_description: Pilgrim's Roasted Nut'Z Creme Brulee Cashews are packaged by hand into either the 8 oz Plastic Cone Bags or 8 Oz Pouch Bags. Label declares Cashews, Sugar, French Vanilla Syrup, Caramel Syrup.
products.reason_for_recall: Creme Brulee Cashews product is recalled due to undeclared walnut.

products.product_description: Pilgrim's Roasted Nut'Z English Toffee Peanuts are packaged by hand into either the 8 oz Plastic Cone Bags or 8 Oz Pouch Bags. Label declares Spanish peanuts, sugar, English Toffee Syrup.
products.reason_for_recall: English Toffee Peanuts product is recalled due to undeclared milk.

products.product_description: Pilgrim's Roasted Nut'Z Garlic, Parmesan, Cracked Black Pepper Hazelnuts are packaged by hand into either the 8 oz Plastic Cone Bags or 8 Oz Pouch Bags. Label declares Hazelnuts, Sugar, Rehydrated Garlic, Cracked Black Pepper, Parmesan Cheese.
products.reason_for_recall: Garlic, Parmesan, Cracked Black Pepper Hazelnuts product is recalled due to undeclared milk.

products.product_description: Pilgrim's Roasted Nut'Z Squirrel Mix are packaged by hand into either the 8 oz Plastic Cone Bags or 8 Oz Pouch Bags. Label declares almonds, Spanish peanuts, mini M&M's, Golden Raisins, Sugar, Vanilla.
products.reason_for_recall: Squirrel Mix product is recalled due to undeclared milk, soy lecithin, and colors: B1, R40, Y5, Y6, and B2.

products.product_description: Pilgrim's Roasted Nut'Z Tri-Colored Chocolate Espresso Beans are packaged by hand into either the 8 oz Plastic Cone Bags or 8 Oz Pouch Bags. Label declares Espresso Beans, Dark Chocolate, Milk Chocolate, Marbled White Chocolate.
products.reason_for_recall: Tri-Colored Chocolate Espresso Beans product is recalled due to undeclared soy lecithin.

products.product_description: Pilgrim's Roasted Nut'Z White Chocolate Raspberry Cashews are packaged by hand into either the 8 oz Plastic Cone Bags or 8 Oz Pouch Bags. Label declares Cashews, Sugar, White Chocolate Cocoa Powder (contains dairy), Vanilla Powder, Raspberry Syrup.
products.reason_for_recall: White Chocolate Raspberry Cashews product is recalled due to undeclared milk and soy lecithin.
